description: AI security audit of a domain: DNS, SPF, DMARC, TLS, HTTP security headers, WHOIS expiry and IP blacklists, returned as a 0-100 score, findings by severity and exact fixes. Requires a paid ipv4.fr API key (X-Api-Key header); uses 10 requests of the daily limit. Without a key, pay per call with x402 (0.05 USDC on Base).
name: domain_audit
